title: Tankers Burn in Hormuz Again. In 1987 It Dragged America Into War #shorts
description:
This week Iran's Revolutionary Guard reported three tankers on fire in the Strait of Hormuz. In 1987, the same waters pulled the US Navy into a war with Iran that ended with 290 people dead on one airliner.

The full story: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xMOSsOmjG7U

Pictures (via Wikimedia Commons): the Front Altair burning, June 2019 — Tasnim News Agency, CC BY 4.0; the tanker Bridgeton, 1987, reflagged Kuwaiti tankers, mines on the Iran Ajr, the frigate Sahand burning, USS Vincennes — US Navy / Department of Defense, public domain; mourners for Iran Air Flight 655 — IRNA, public domain.
Music: Beyond the Lows — The Whole Other.
